page.title: Card step for Beech cutting board

product.name: Beech cutting board
product.description: The board is beech, edge grain, with a juice groove.

blocks.text: No sleeve is ticked. No repeat parcel is marked.
Fragile glass leaves the stockroom in a double mailer.
You are paying Kindling Co at www.kindlingco.example.
The form wants the digits on the plastic, the month and year, and the short code on the back.
It does not ask for the sign-in secret of your bank site.
The host in the header is the shop you opened. The tag on Beech cutting board matches the amount due.
